scope: Four predeclared development episodes of v6 sampled reset-clearance, three correlated robots and six tasks each. All v5 outcomes retained; no post-outcome tuning.

model_mission.scope: Recorded model output, complete-language certificate and executed tree agree; fresh sensor grounding and physical outcomes are separate checks.

validation.scope: Current continuous one-second placement from retained sampled geometry/contact/speed/clearance/grip; controller-only dependency ordering and exact workcell pairs. Dynamics are not reconstructed. Legacy probes without initial-state hashes report a computed hash only, not independently anchored initial-state verification.
